author: SergeantBoom
body:
Ah yes, PvP logging. It seems to be more frequent now then it used to be. Its extremely annoying when you get into a heated battle and then all of a sudden your opponent wimps out and logs, and it has become more frequent.

 For example, i was literally just in a game of Nebula on Frostbite where i was in iron gear and going up against a fully deckedout diamond player, of course the only logical way to win that fight easily, quickly, and take the least amount of damage would be to knock him off the map. So, i did. After several seconds i see the kill feed did not come up, so i tabbed in on his name...

Long story short, i would love to see an anti-pvplog plugin introduced.

Thanks!
